# missing key

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:opacityMissingKey`](gmeow-opacityMissingKey.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/opacityMissingKey>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The frame is sealed with an encrypt-class codec and the reader holds no key for it; the declared recipients ([`gmeow:sealedRecipient`](../properties/gmeow-sealedRecipient.md)) can decrypt it.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:opacityMissingKey`](gmeow-opacityMissingKey.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md).
